title: Verification scripts for: Quantum rigidity of prime-order circulants via two-basepoint Terwilliger algebras
description:
Exact-arithmetic verification of every computational claim in the paper Quantum rigidity of prime-order circulants via two-basepoint Terwilliger algebras.

Part A checks the four capture certificates of Section 7 (p = 13, 17, 31, 41) and their optimality. Part B checks the confinement lemma, the sharpness of the count (k-1)(k-2), the quadratic threshold p > (k-1)(k-2) + 2, the enumeration of the eight residual pairs in types at most 10, and their singleton-block witnesses. Part C reruns the saturation of Theorem 8.1 for all 214 pairs (p, E) with p ≤ 250, over the rationals for small p and over F_q with q = 1000003 throughout. Part D recomputes the capture depths of Definition 5.14 from scratch, in exact integer arithmetic, and checks the structural and harmonic observations of Section 8.2 together with Table 1 of Appendix A. No floating-point arithmetic is used anywhere.
